translations.web: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.
translations.bsb: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare— not knowing it will cost him his life.
translations.kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
translations.asv: Till an arrow strike through his liver; As a bird hasteth to the snare, And knoweth not that it is for his life.
